what_it_does: Caracal is a sparse linear system solver that runs directly on GPUs with improved performance through better task scheduling and memory management. It uses a two-level scheduling strategy to manage work efficiently across GPU processors. The solver optimizes how GPU processors communicate with each other to avoid bottlenecks. It maintains frequently-accessed data in fast GPU memory to reduce data movement overhead. The approach is designed to work well when solving systems across multiple GPUs connected by high-speed links.
